Third Sunday in Ordinary Time September 6 2026 This weekend September 5th 6th the Church celebrates the Twenty third Sunday in Ordinary Time As Ezekiel is appointed watchman over the house of Israel in today's first Reading so Jesus in the Gospel today continues to establish His disciples as guardians of the new Israel and house of God the Church cf Gal 616 Ezekiel also puts in place procedures for dealing with sin and breaches of the faith building on the rules of discipline as prescribed by Moses for Israel cf Lev 1917 20 Deut 1913 The heads of the new Israel in the Church however receive extraordinary powers similar to those given to Peter cf Matt 1619 They have the power to bind and loose to forgive sins and to reconcile sinners in His name cf John 2021 23 These powers given by our Lord to the Apostles and their successors depend on their communion with Him As Ezekiel is only to teach what he hears God saying so the disciples can only perform these mighty deeds by acting in His name Just as we all are to gather in His name and to pray and seek out the will of our heavenly Father how much more so must the leaders of the Church do so when acting in persona Christi capitas in the person of Christ the head Discover Catholicism We had a wonderful turn out and introduction to our Discover Catholicism series this past Thursday As a reminder this weekly series on Thursdays at 6:30PM in the Parish Conference Room is open to all Even if you may not be able to join us every week feel free to join whenever you can If you or someone you know is interested in this series and in joining the Catholic Church this coming year but our Thursday time does not work for their calendar please have them contact me through the Parish Office We will do everything possible for those desiring to formally enter the Church to make sure their preparation can move forward Parish Renovation Updates The end is getting closer On Tuesday members of our parish and finance councils joined Shawnee Construction for what was scheduled as a punch list walk through punch list highlights any remaining or incomplete tasks to be fixed before a project is finished When we began however the team let us know that despite being scheduled as such we are not yet at the punch list stage Instead we reviewed the progress so far Regarding our progress after having several pieces re milled multiple times we have only this past week received the last of our woodworking package from Big Lumber in Fort Wayne This woodworking will be installed as work on the sanctuary flooring is completed over the next week Once the sanctuary flooring is done scaffolding will be rebuilt to allow any remaining woodworking in the sanctuary that needs it to be stained and sealed Once this work is complete we will then hopefully be at the true punch list stage as finishing work begins Thankfully many punch list items can be addressed after our sanctuary has been reopened for use After our progress meeting this past Tuesday Shawnee Construction is preparing an updated timeline As of our talks this past Friday we hope to be back in the sanctuary for our weekend Masses by the end of the month Thank you for your patience during this project When this project began in January I thought we had built in a number of safeguards to account for all possible delays and issues As we now enter our ninth month of work I've learned many lessons that ll be useful for my pastoral ministry and future building projects Though it may be taking longer than desired the end result for our parish family and the glory of God will be more than worth it The construction is done with toil the dedication is carried out with joy St Augustine Sermon 336 on the Dedication of a Church AD 425 Saturday September 5 400 4:45pm
